decision: Drop stale url via destructure-omit (const { url: _drop, ...rest } = existing) then spread rest
reasoning: destructure-omit is pure/immutable and keeps merge a clean total fn per Q2; delete mutates the spread object
risk: if existing shape nests url elsewhere the omit misses it, but research confirms url is top-level on the entry

decision: No-op short-circuit requires serverUrl AND headers.Authorization===authHeader AND enabledTools includes '*' AND no url key, all four
reasoning: four-part conjunction per context.md constraint; treats any drift (missing enabledTools, stale url, narrowed tools) as needing rewrite
risk: authHeader is token-derived; if on-disk token differs from resolved token the merge rewrites header (correct, same token in practice)

decision: Tighten mergeAntigravityMcpRegistration param from token?:string to required token:string (total fn over present token)
reasoning: Q2 contract: wrapper gates token, merge only runs with present token; no external callers (grep-verified), barrel re-export carries no separate signature; strengthens static guarantee behind anti-02
risk: intermediate tsc break if 1.1.4 tightens before 1.1.3 adds wrapper guard - mitigated by dep edge 1.1.4<-1.1.3 (land as one tsc-clean unit)

decision: Staged only wire-claude-hooks.ts + phase artifacts, not 'git add .'
reasoning: Working tree has ~10 pre-existing unrelated modified files (test files, package.json, other utils) from prior work. A blanket 'git add .' would violate the 'ONE logical change per commit' constraint and bundle unrelated changes into the Antigravity-fix commit.
risk: If the orchestrator expected those other changes committed here, they remain unstaged; but they are out of this task's scope.
reviewHint: Confirm the unrelated dirty files belong to a different phase/commit.
